<h2>一、产品总览</h2>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">Surging AI Agent（取名：AgentForge，自研开发助手智能体 DevAgent），是<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">深度原生集成 Surging 微服务引擎</strong>的.NET 专属本地 AI 智能体，依托<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">engine-cli</code>命令行终端交互，一站式实现框架答疑、配置生成、微服务模块创建、代码编译、集群部署全自动化研发流程。
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
下方为本地<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">engine-cli</code>真实运行交互截图，直观展示对话问答、工程流水线、轻量化离线运行效果：</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<p><img alt="546083ccab50a1836dad53fb598e459e" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/192878/202606/192878-20260630220129273-1967269004.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><strong>核心场景解读</strong></h3>
<p>&nbsp;<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">1、自然语言对话问答</strong></p>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">&nbsp;终端直接提问，Agent 输出结构化说明 + 可直接复制的 JSON 配置：Surging 框架介绍、服务 IP 部署、OAuth2 网关鉴权、IP 黑白名单生产级配置；支持标准工具函数调度（时间查询<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">GetCurrentTime</code>标准化 JSON 调用结构）。</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">2、全自动微服务工程流水线</strong></p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">输入需求<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">生成订单中心模块代码，输出WebApi，目标框架.NET8.0</code>，自动串行执行：<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">GenerateModule → Compile → Deploy</code>，无需人工分步操作。</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">3、低资源离线本地推理</strong></p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">右侧任务管理器可见<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">engine-cli</code>进程内存占用仅 5.5G，基于 C# 原生 LLamaSharp 推理，相比其它语言 Agent 硬件门槛大幅降低，适配政务、金融内网信创离线场景。</p>
<h2>二、智能体组件注册入口：DevAgentSupportProvider</h2>
<p>该类是 Surging 标准组件扩展，引擎启动自动加载 DevAgent 智能体，统一完成智能体基础信息、工具插件挂载、分层 RAG 知识库、多智能体编排提示词注册。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DevAgentSupportProvider : ComponentSupportProvider
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> IObservable&lt;IComponentSupport&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Create(ComponentContext context)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化智能体实例，并发权重2</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> support = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AgentSupport(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        support.Id </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DevAgent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        support.Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">开发助手智能体</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        support.Author </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fanly</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; 
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 挂载内置工具插件</span>
        support.AddAgentPluginSupport(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Time</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(TimePlugin));
        support.AddAgentPluginSupport(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CodeGenerator</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(CodeGeneratorPlugin));

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可选：支持远程surging服务、MCP (GRPC/HTTP)插件接入
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">support.AddAgentPluginSupport("CodeGenerator", new ServiceDescriptor { RoutePath = "/plugin/codeGenerator/generatemodule" });
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">support.AddAgentPluginSupport("CodeGenerator","grpc:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">127.0.0.1/plugin/codeGenerator/generatemodule");
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">support.AddAgentPluginSupport("CodeGenerator", "</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1); text-decoration: underline">http://127.0.0.1/plugin/codeGenerator/generatemodule</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">");

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 静态框架知识库（Knowledge类型，问答检索核心数据源）</span>

            { </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tags</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">surging</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">microservice</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">微服务引擎</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} },

        support.AddRAGDocument(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Knowledges/surging-setting.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, context.ComponentLocation, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">surging_setting_doc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tags: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 单智能体角色提示词（Agent类型，定义DevAgent基础行为规范）</span>
        support.AddRAGDocument(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Prompts/agent-prompt.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, context.ComponentLocation, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">agent-engine-cli_doc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tags: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            { </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tags</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">engine-cli</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cli tool</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">agent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai tool</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai助手</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} },
        }).AddDocType(RAGDocumentType.Agent);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 多智能体串行编排提示词（Sequential类型，支撑大型项目分工协同）</span>
        support.AddRAGDocument(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Prompts/agentgroup-prompt.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, context.ComponentLocation, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">agentgroup-engine-cli_doc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tags: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            { </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tags</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">engine-cli</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cli tool</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">agentgroup</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai tool</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai助手</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} },
        }).AddAdditionalDescPath(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Prompts/agentgroup-desc.md</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context.ComponentLocation)
          .AddDocType(RAGDocumentType.Sequential);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Observable.Return(support);
    }
}</span></pre>

<p>3. 配套入参实体（统一结构化入参规范）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

<h2>四、核心亮点</h2>
<p>1、标准 SemanticKernel 规范开发</p>
<p>全部工具基于<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">[KernelFunction]</code>官方注解实现，强类型结构化入参，AI 自动识别函数、自动组装参数，不会出现通用 Agent 参数错乱、无法落地的问题；同时支持本地 C# 插件 、Surging微服务插件、MCP( GRPC/HTTP) 插件扩展。</p>
<p>2、Surging 原生内置，无额外中间件依赖</p>
<p>通过<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">ComponentSupportProvider</code>作为标准组件注册进微服务引擎，引擎启动自动加载 AI 智能体，深度打通 RPC、服务注册、集群发布底层能力，生成代码开箱即用。</p>
<p>3、精细化分层 RAG 知识库</p>
<p>区分框架文档、单智能体提示词、多智能体串行编排文档，标签向量检索相似度稳定≥95%，精准解答 Surging 各类配置、运维、部署问题。</p>
<p>4、轻量化离线私有化运行</p>
<p>依托 LLamaSharp C# 原生推理，截图可见仅 5.5G 内存即可运行llama3.1 8B_4Q 大模型、BGE向量模型，无外网数据上传，完美适配金融、政务、国企信创内网隔离场景。</p>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;5、<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">CLI 终端深度融合</strong></div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">开发者无需切换 IDE、网页、客户端，日常使用<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">engine-cli</code>时直接对话 AI，把 AI 能力嵌入原有开发工作流，学习成本极低。</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<h2>五、适用场景</h2>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">1、Surging 新手快速开发：一句话生成标准微服务模块，搭配知识库答疑快速上手框架；</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">2、内网离线信创研发：本地私有化大模型，数据不出内网，满足安全合规要求；</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">3、大型分布式系统协同开发：多智能体 Sequential、Concurrent、Handoff、GroupChat、Magentic五种模式拆分复杂任务编排协同；</p>
<h2>总结</h2>
</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">市面上的AI Agent 和微服务架构完全割裂；而 Surging的&nbsp;AgentForge从<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">底层组件注册、标准化 Kernel 插件、分层 RAG 知识库、CLI 终端离线推理</strong>全链路深度绑定.NET 微服务生态，拥有完整可落地的自动化交付能力，让.NET有一战之力。</div>
